Calendar subscription

Add to Google
Calendar.

Google Calendar needs you to paste the subscription URL yourself. Copy it below, then complete the following steps in a desktop browser.

Your subscription URL

  1. Copy the URL above.Use “Copy URL”, or select and copy the address yourself.
  2. Open Google Calendar below.Sign in to the Google account you want to use. The link opens Settings → Add calendar → From URL.
  3. Paste and add the calendar.Paste the copied address into “URL of calendar”, then click “Add calendar”. It will appear under “Other calendars”.
